messages.subject: Critical minerals and corporate affairs | Executive introduction from Ragunauth Ramsaroop
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Woodgate,

Iluka's critical-minerals and rare-earths growth agenda brings corporate affairs, government engagement, regulatory coordination and community confidence together in a way closely aligned with my current mandate.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities span government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead institutional engagement, coordinate complex regulatory and stakeholder matters across operations, environment, HSE, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams, and translate external commitments into accountable owners and evidence. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I am exploring senior international roles where this combination of mining, corporate affairs, government relations and sustainability execution could support strategic growth. Iluka's position in critical minerals makes your agenda especially relevant to my experience.

I would value a conversation about where my background might support Iluka's corporate-affairs, government-relations or strategic stakeholder priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Iluka Resources.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
